'''Nathan Jacob Fine''' (22 October 1916 in [[Philadelphia, Pennsylvania|Philadelphia]] – 18 November 1994 in [[Deerfield Beach]], [[Florida]]) was an American [[mathematician]] who worked on [[basic hypergeometric series]].  

== Сareer ==
He is best known for his lecture notes on the subject which for four decades served as an inspiration to experts in the field until they were finally published as a book. He solved the [[Jeep problem]] in 1946.

Nathan Fine retired in 1978, as a professor at [[Pennsylvania State University]].  Prior to that he had been on the faculties of the [[University of Pennsylvania]] and [[Cornell University]].  For a brief period (1946&ndash;1947) he also worked at the Operations Evaluation Group, affiliated with the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]]. Beside the book he published about 40 papers in several fields of mathematics. He is known for the Rogers-Fine identity.<ref>{{cite book|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3bZQDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA71|chapter=Chapter 9. The Rogers-Fine identity|pages=71–79|title = Topics and Methods in q-Series|isbn = 9789813223387|last1 = Laughlin|first1 = James Mc|date = 22 September 2017 |publisher=World Scientific }}</ref>

Nathan Fine received his Ph.D. in 1946 from [[University of Pennsylvania]], where he was a student of [[Antoni Zygmund]]. Fine was at the Institute for Advanced Study for the three academic years 1953–1954, 1958–1959, and 1959–1960.<ref>{{cite web|title=Natham J. Fine|website=Institute for Advanced Study|date=9 December 2019 |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/nathan-j-fine}}</ref> Fine's doctoral students include [[Justin Jesse Price|J. J. Price]].

He wrote the book ''Basic Hypergeometric Series and Applications'' {{ISBN|0-8218-1524-5}}.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Askey, Richard|title=Review: Nathan J. Fine, ''Basic hypergeometric series and applications''|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. (N.S.)|year=1989| volume=21|issue=1|pages=130–132|url=http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.bams/1183555138|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1989-15789-3|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=JmzyBwAAQBAJ|title = Basic Hypergeometric Series and Applications|isbn = 9780821815243|last1 = Fine|first1 = Nathan Jacob|year = 1988| publisher=American Mathematical Soc. |postscript=; pbk edition}}</ref>
